evidence: Modifies top-level and test `CMakeLists.txt` files and CI configuration scripts (`ci/test/03_test_script.sh`) to optionally register functional tests under CTest.
rationale: Integrating functional tests into CTest provides developer convenience and CI flexibility by exposing standard CTest features such as `-R`, `--rerun-failed`, and parallel execution. It is an opt-in enhancement to build and CI tooling rather than a fix for broken builds or CI reliability issues.
